testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.screens.review.ReviewContentTest

testcase.name: a superseded card says it is read-only and disables revert
a populated card carries its turn header counts and row actions
revert is confirmed named and cancel-safe
the project label and capture time are in the card provenance
a running turn disables revert with an explicit banner
a reverted path is labelled and cannot revert twice
the export outcome message is rendered
a chat pool scope explains that no file changes are collected
an empty history explains the process scope
export carries the frozen root and relative path
a not-measured turn says so and offers no revert
unreadable and no-diff cards keep their honest explanation
